blocking_failures: anti_cheating_measures: normalize.c source is present in environment/normalize.c and is copied during build before being removed from /tmp; however the file is still accessible in the image build context. More critically, gen_samples.py contains the comment '# (hiding the MIN-as-P90 bug on uniform input)' which directly reveals the bug the agent is supposed to discover. The instruction claims 'no source available' but the source is in the environment directory.

structured_data_schema: The instruction mentions interval_stats and circuit_demand tables but does not specify their exact schema (column names, types). Tests check specific columns like p90_power, avg_power, sample_count, total_kwh, meter_count, hour that are not documented in instruction.md or any referenced spec file.

valid_failure_modes: test.sh downloads uv from astral.sh over the internet at test time (curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.9.5/install.sh). This external network call can fail due to network issues unrelated to the agent's solution quality, making a correct solution fail non-deterministically.
advice: verify_time_inputs: The tests operate on the pre-seeded /app/data/raw_samples.csv generated at image build time with a fixed seed. The test fixture reads this existing file rather than generating fresh unseen inputs. A solution that only works on this specific seeded dataset could pass without generalizing.
